prepared: literally, the opposite of ease, when something is wrong with a bodily function. an interruption, cessation, or disorder of functions at the level of psyche, mind or body.

en: the term literally signifies disease, originating from physical or mental si ns of the individual in present or past life. .
hi: शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ है बीमारी, जो वर्तमान या पिछले जीवन में व्यक्ति के शारीरिक या मानसिक अनुभव से उत्पन्न होती है।
prepared: the term literally signifies disease, originating from physical or mental si ns of the individual in present or past life. .

en: a disease that gives rise to another disease and still continues to exist. it can also signify a condition when two or more diseases co-exist together and may produce as a result of similarity in etiology, or pathogenic mechanism.
hi: एक ऐसी बीमारी जो किसी अन्य रोग को जन्म देती है और अभी भी मौजूद है। यह एक ऐसी स्थिति को भी दर्शा सकती है जब दो या दो से अधिक रोग एक साथ मौजूद होते हैं और निदान (कारण) या रोगजनक तंत्र में समानता के परिणामस्वरूप उत्पन्न हो सकते हैं।
prepared: a disease that gives rise to another disease and still continues to exist. it can also signify a condition when two or more diseases co-exist together and may produce as a result of similarity in निदान (कारण), or pathogenic mechanism.

en: the term signifies the categorization of diseases as per various criteria.
hi: इस शब्द का अर्थ विभिन्न मानदंडों के अनुसार रोगों को वर्गीकृत करना है।
prepared: the term signifies the categorization of diseases as per various criteria.

en: the diseases which affects the psyche, can be classified as rajasika and tamasika
hi: मानसिक रोगों को राजसिका और तामसिका के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जा सकता है।
prepared: the diseases which affects the psyche, can be classified as rajasika and tamasika

en: disorders of psyche caused by increase in rajo guna in the individual such as excessive anger, jealousy etc
hi: व्यक्ति में रायो गुणों में वृद्धि से होने वाली मानसिक विकार जैसे कि अत्यधिक क्रोध, ईर्ष्या आदि
prepared: disorders of psyche caused by increase in rajo गुण in the individual such as excessive anger, jealousy etc

en: disorders of psyche caused by increase in tamo guna in the individual such as grief, slothfulness, excessive sleepiness etc
hi: व्यक्ति में तमो गुणों में वृद्धि से होने वाली मानसिक विकार जैसे दुख, आलस्य, अत्यधिक नींद आदि
prepared: disorders of psyche caused by increase in tamo गुण in the individual such as grief, slothfulness, excessive sleepiness etc

en: classification of somatic diseases on the basis of vitiation of sareerika doshas
hi: सररीका दोष के दुष्टि (प्रकोप) के आधार पर संधि रोगों का वर्गीकरण
prepared: classification of somatic diseases on the basis of दुष्टि (प्रकोप) of sareerika दोष

en: this term implies diseases caused by vitiation of pitta dosha such as amlapitta, raktapitta, kamala etc.
hi: इस शब्द में पित्त दोष के दुष्टि (प्रकोप) से होने वाली बीमारियों जैसे अम्लापिट्टा, रकटपीट्टा, कमला आदि को शामिल किया गया है।
prepared: this term implies diseases caused by दुष्टि (प्रकोप) of पित्त दोष such as amlapitta, raktapitta, kamala etc.

en: this term implies diseases caused by vitiated kapha dosha in the body such as aruchi.
hi: इस शब्द में शरीर में प्रकुपित कफ दोष जैसे कि आरुची से होने वाली बीमारियों को दर्शाया गया है।
prepared: this term implies diseases caused by प्रकुपित कफ दोष in the body such as aruchi.

en: this term implies diseases produced by vitiated vata dosha in the body such as sandhivata, gridhrasi, pakshaghata etc
hi: इस शब्द में शरीर में प्रकुपित वात दोष से उत्पन्न होने वाली बीमारियां जैसे संधिवत, ग्रिधरासी, पाकशाघट आदि शामिल हैं।
prepared: this term implies diseases produced by प्रकुपित वात दोष in the body such as sandhivata, gridhrasi, pakshaghata etc

en: three fold classification of diseases by acharya susruta on the basis of etiology.
hi: निदान (कारण) के आधार पर आचार्य सुस्रुता द्वारा रोगों का तीन गुना वर्गीकरण।
prepared: three fold classification of diseases by acharya susruta on the basis of निदान (कारण).

en: this term signifies diseases produced as a result of affliction of psyche and body, all psychosomatic diseases are included in this categorisation.
hi: इस शब्द का अर्थ है मानसिक और शारीरिक विकारों के परिणामस्वरूप उत्पन्न होने वाली बीमारियां, सभी मनोसोमाटिक बीमारियों को इस वर्गीकरण में शामिल किया गया है।
prepared: this term signifies diseases produced as a result of affliction of psyche and body, all psychosomatic diseases are included in this categorisation.

en: diseases caused due to morbidity of sperm and ovum and all hereditary diseases are classified under this.
hi: शुक्राणु और अंडाशय की रोगाणुता के कारण होने वाली बीमारियों तथा सभी आनुवंशिक बीमारियों को इस श्रेणी में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।
prepared: diseases caused due to morbidity of sperm and ovum and all hereditary diseases are classified under this.

en: hereditary anomalies inherited through maternal genetic defects due to morbidity in ovum
hi: अंडाशय में रोगाणु के कारण मातृ आनुवंशिक दोषों के कारण विरासत में मिली आनुवंशिक विसंगति
prepared: hereditary anomalies inherited through maternal genetic defects due to morbidity in ovum

en: hereditary anomalies inherited through paternal genetic defects due to morbidity in sperm
hi: शुक्राणु में रोगाणुत्व के कारण पिता की आनुवंशिक दोषों के कारण विरासत में मिली आनुवंशिक विसंगति
prepared: hereditary anomalies inherited through paternal genetic defects due to morbidity in sperm

en: diseases that occur at the time of birth due to improper dietetics and life style practices followed by mother during conception and various stages of foetal development.
hi: गर्भधारण और भ्रूण विकास के विभिन्न चरणों के दौरान माता द्वारा अनुचित आहार और जीवन शैली अभ्यास के कारण जन्म के समय होने वाली बीमारियां।
prepared: diseases that occur at the time of birth due to improper dietetics and life style practices followed by mother during conception and various stages of foetal development.

en: congenital disorders that occur in infant due to dietary indiscretions of the mother practiced during conception and pregnancy.
hi: गर्भधारण और गर्भावस्था के दौरान माता द्वारा आहार संबंधी अनभिज्ञता के कारण शिशु में उत्पन्न होने वाले जन्मजात विकार।
prepared: congenital disorders that occur in infant due to dietary indiscretions of the mother practiced during conception and pregnancy.

en: the congenital or other diseases that occur in the infant due to non-fulfillment of mothers cravings during pregnancy.
hi: जन्मजात या अन्य रोग जो गर्भावस्था के दौरान माताओं की इच्छाओं को पूरा न करने के कारण शिशु में होते हैं।
prepared: the congenital or other diseases that occur in the infant due to non-fulfillment of mothers cravings during pregnancy.

en: diseases that manifest in the body due to vitiation of body humors such as jwara, raktapitta etc.
hi: शरीर में जो रोग शरीर के हास्य जैसे ज्वारा, रकटपीट्टा आदि के दुष्टि (प्रकोप) के कारण प्रकट होते हैं।
prepared: diseases that manifest in the body due to दुष्टि (प्रकोप) of body humors such as jwara, raktapitta etc.

en: diseases which have their origin in the gastro-duodenal tract such as amlapitta(hyperacidity), chardi(vomiting ).
hi: पेट-दूधनाली मार्ग में उत्पन्न होने वाली बीमारियां जैसे कि अम्लापिटा, अतिचिकित्सा, चार्डी, छर्दि (उल्टी) ।
prepared: diseases which have their origin in the gastro-duodenal tract such as amlapitta(hyperacidity), chardi(छर्दि (उल्टी) ).

en: diseases which have their origin in the large intestinal tract such as arsas(piles), udavartha(constipation) etc
hi: बड़ी आंत की चपेट में उत्पन्न होने वाली बीमारियां जैसे कि अर्श (बवासीर), उदावartha (विबंध (कब्ज़)) आदि
prepared: diseases which have their origin in the large intestinal tract such as arsas(अर्श (बवासीर)), udavartha(विबंध (कब्ज़)) etc

en: diseases caused in the body due to exogenous or traumatic causes such as injury from accidents, fall or from animal bite or poisons.
hi: शरीर में बाहरी या आघातकारी कारणों जैसे दुर्घटनाओं, गिरने या पशु के काटने या जहर से होने वाली चोटों से होने वाली बीमारियां।
prepared: diseases caused in the body due to exogenous or traumatic causes such as injury from accidents, fall or from animal bite or poisons.

en: diseases caused by trauma such as accidents, falls etc.
hi: दुर्घटनाओं, गिरने आदि जैसे आघात से होने वाली बीमारियां
prepared: diseases caused by trauma such as accidents, falls etc.

en: diseases caused by weapons or instruments such as swords, surgical instruments, stones, wood etc.
hi: हथियारों या उपकरणों जैसे तलवारों, सर्जिकल उपकरणों, पत्थरों, लकड़ी आदि से होने वाली बीमारियां।
prepared: diseases caused by weapons or instruments such as swords, surgical instruments, stones, wood etc.

en: the diseases which are produced due to attack and bite of tame and wild animals and include attacks by animals and injuries caused by their nails, horns and bites, snake poison, bee sting etc.
hi: जो कि पालतू और जंगली जानवरों के हमले और काटने से उत्पन्न होती हैं और इनमें जानवरों द्वारा हमले और उनके नाखूनों, सींगों और काटने, सांप विष, मधुमक्खी के काटने आदि से होने वाली चोटें शामिल हैं।
prepared: the diseases which are produced due to attack and bite of tame and wild animals and include attacks by animals and injuries caused by their nails, horns and bites, snake विष, bee sting etc.

en: diseases that arise out of disturbances in nature such as natural calamities, seasonal or climatic variations or due to tempestuous divine interventions such as floods, epidemics, draught etc.
hi: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं, मौसमी या जलवायु परिवर्तन जैसे प्राकृतिक व्यवधानों या तूफान के कारण होने वाली बीमारियां, जैसे बाढ़, महामारी, बाढ़ आदि।
prepared: diseases that arise out of disturbances in nature such as natural calamities, seasonal or climatic variations or due to tempestuous divine interventions such as floods, epidemics, draught etc.

en: diseases that are manifested in the body due to abnormal variations in the climate such as due to excessive rain, excessive heat, excessive cold and include conditions such as heatstroke, frost bite etc.
hi: ऐसी बीमारियां जो शरीर में जलवायु में असामान्य परिवर्तनों के कारण प्रकट होती हैं जैसे अत्यधिक वर्षा, अत्यधिक गर्मी, अत्यधिक ठंड और इनमें गर्मी का झटका, ठंढ का काटना आदि जैसी स्थितियां शामिल हैं।
prepared: diseases that are manifested in the body due to abnormal variations in the climate such as due to excessive rain, excessive heat, excessive cold and include conditions such as heatstroke, frost bite etc.

en: diseases that manifest in the body due to unexpected variation in the character of seasons such as excessive rain during rainy season, excessive snowfall during winter etc.
hi: शरीर में ऐसे रोग जो मौसम की प्रकृति में अप्रत्याशित परिवर्तन के कारण प्रकट होते हैं जैसे वर्षा के मौसम में अत्यधिक वर्षा, सर्दियों में अत्यधिक बर्फबारी आदि।
prepared: diseases that manifest in the body due to unexpected variation in the character of seasons such as excessive rain during rainy season, excessive snowfall during winter etc.

en: the diseases that are caused due to vitiation of body humors that are consistent with that of a normal season and manifests mainly because of non-adaptation of suitable dietetics and regimen prescribed for that season.
hi: शरीर के हास्यों के दुष्टि (प्रकोप) के कारण होने वाली बीमारियां जो एक सामान्य मौसम के साथ संगत हैं और मुख्यतः उस मौसम के लिए निर्धारित उपयुक्त आहार और आहार के अनुपालन के अभाव के कारण प्रकट होती हैं।
prepared: the diseases that are caused due to दुष्टि (प्रकोप) of body humors that are consistent with that of a normal season and manifests mainly because of non-adaptation of suitable dietetics and regimen prescribed for that season.

en: diseases that are believed to be caused by divine or supernatural causes without any other apparent cause and includes diseases caused by destruction by natural calamities such as floods, cyclones etc.
hi: ऐसी बीमारियां जो किसी अन्य स्पष्ट कारण के बिना दिव्य या अलौकिक कारणों से होने का अनुमान लगाया जाता है और इनमें प्राकृतिक आपदाओं जैसे बाढ़, चक्रवात आदि द्वारा विनाश के कारण होने वाली बीमारियां शामिल हैं।
prepared: diseases that are believed to be caused by divine or supernatural causes without any other apparent cause and includes diseases caused by destruction by natural calamities such as floods, cyclones etc.

en: diseases caused by natural disasters such as thunder, lightning, asteroids and fall of comets on earth surface
hi: प्राकृतिक आपदाओं जैसे कि गरज, बिजली, क्षुद्रग्रह और पृथ्वी की सतह पर धूमकेतुओं के गिरने से होने वाली बीमारियां
prepared: diseases caused by natural disasters such as thunder, lightning, asteroids and fall of comets on earth surface

en: diseases caused by ominous evil forces such as spirits etc are included in this.
hi: इसमें दुष्ट शक्तियों जैसे आत्माओं आदि द्वारा होने वाली बीमारियां शामिल हैं।
prepared: diseases caused by ominous evil forces such as spirits etc are included in this.

en: diseases that are caused and transmitted in individuals by close contact or by being in proximity with individuals affected with some diseases such as kushta( leprosy), netrabhisyanda( conjunctivitis) etc
hi: ऐसी बीमारियां जो किसी व्यक्ति में घनिष्ठ संपर्क या कुछ बीमारियों जैसे कुष्ठ, नेत्रबिधान, जोड़ जोड़शोथ आदि से प्रभावित व्यक्तियों के निकट रहने से होती हैं और उन्हें लोगों में फैलाती हैं।
prepared: diseases that are caused and transmitted in individuals by close contact or by being in proximity with individuals affected with some diseases such as kushta( कुष्ठ), netrabhisyanda( conjunctivitis) etc

en: the diseases which manifest suddenly in the body without any apparent cause.
hi: ऐसी बीमारियां जो शरीर में अचानक बिना किसी स्पष्ट कारण के प्रकट होती हैं।
prepared: the diseases which manifest suddenly in the body without any apparent cause.

en: a variety of diseases, brought about by natural progression of bodily processes such as hunger, thirst, sleep, old age etc.
hi: विभिन्न प्रकार की बीमारियां, जो शरीर की प्रक्रियाओं जैसे भूख, प्यास, नींद, बुढ़ापे आदि की प्राकृतिक प्रगति से उत्पन्न होती हैं।
prepared: a variety of diseases, brought about by natural progression of bodily processes such as hunger, thirst, sleep, old age etc.

en: the diseases that manifest in the body naturally due to the effect of time and physiological progression such as ageing, wrinkling, greying of hair etc.
hi: शरीर में समय और शारीरिक प्रगति के प्रभाव से स्वाभाविक रूप से प्रकट होने वाली बीमारियां जैसे कि उम्र बढ़ने, झुर्रियों, बालों के पित्तावस्था आदि।
prepared: the diseases that manifest in the body naturally due to the effect of time and physiological progression such as ageing, wrinkling, greying of hair etc.

en: the conditions that manifest prior to their natural time of occurrence in the body due to improper dietetics, erratic lifestyles etc such as premature greying and wrinkling etc.
hi: शरीर में उनके प्राकृतिक होने से पहले प्रकट होने वाली स्थितियां, जो अनुचित आहार, अनियमित जीवनशैली आदि जैसे कि समय से पहले ग्रेइंग और झुर्रियां आदि के कारण होती हैं।
prepared: the conditions that manifest prior to their natural time of occurrence in the body due to improper dietetics, erratic lifestyles etc such as premature greying and wrinkling etc.

en: the classification of diseases based on their prognosis such as good prognosis(sadhya), incurable(asadhya), curable with difficulty( krichrasadhya) and palliative (yapya)
hi: रोगों का वर्गीकरण उनकी भविष्यवाणी के आधार पर जैसे कि अच्छा भविष्यवाणी, उपचार योग्य, मुश्किल से इलाज योग्य, क्रिकेशात्मक और उपचारात्मक (यापिया)
prepared: the classification of diseases based on their prognosis such as good prognosis(sadhya), incurable(asadhya), curable with difficulty( krichrasadhya) and palliative (yapya)

en: diseases having good prognosis such as chardi (vomiting), mandagni ( depleted digestive fire).
hi: चार्डी (छर्दि (उल्टी)), मंडाग्नि (खराब जठराग्नि) जैसी रोगों की अच्छी भविष्यवाणी।
prepared: diseases having good prognosis such as chardi (छर्दि (उल्टी)), mandagni ( depleted जठराग्नि).

en: easily curable diseases, having less causative factors, less amount of vitiation of doṣa and manifested in comparatively less deteriorated body tissues.
hi: कम कारणों से होने वाली रोग, कम दुष्टि (प्रकोप) की मात्रा और शरीर के ऊतकों में अपेक्षाकृत कम बिगड़ने वाली रोग।
prepared: easily curable diseases, having less causative factors, less amount of दुष्टि (प्रकोप) of दोष and manifested in comparatively less deteriorated body tissues.

en: the diseases that are curable with difficulty owing to various factors such as multiplicity of etiological factors, depleted strength of individual, diseases involving multiple tissue; including diseases such as piles caused by involvement of two body humors.
hi: ऐसे रोग जो विभिन्न कारकों जैसे कि अनेक कारणों के कारण, अनेक कारणों के कारण, व्यक्ति की शक्ति कम होने, कई ऊतकों को शामिल करने वाली बीमारियों के कारण, उपचार में कठिनाई के साथ हो सकते हैं; जिसमें अर्श (बवासीर) जैसे रोग शामिल हैं जो दो शरीर के हास्यों की भागीदारी से उत्पन्न होते हैं।
prepared: the diseases that are curable with difficulty owing to various factors such as multiplicity of etiological factors, depleted strength of individual, diseases involving multiple tissue; including diseases such as अर्श (बवासीर) caused by involvement of two body humors.

en: the diseases which are incurable owing to involvement of all body humors, multiple tissues and tracts and presenting with arishta lakshana(signs that are markers of impending death) and includes diseases such as urdhwaswasa(severe respiratory disease), hemorrhagic diathesis due to all humors etc
hi: शरीर के सभी हास्यों, कई ऊतकों और पंचांगों की भागीदारी के कारण उपचार योग्य होने वाली बीमारियां और अरिष्ट लक्ष्णा के साथ प्रस्तुत होने वाले लक्षण जो मृत्यु के आसन्न संकेत हैं) और इनमें ऑर्जुवासा (अग्र श्वसन रोग) जैसे रोग शामिल हैं, सभी हास्यों के कारण रक्तस्राव डायथेसिस आदि शामिल हैं।
prepared: the diseases which are incurable owing to involvement of all body humors, multiple tissues and tracts and presenting with arishta lakshana(signs that are markers of impending death) and includes diseases such as urdhwaswasa(severe respiratory disease), hemorrhagic diathesis due to all humors etc

en: the diseases which by nature are not completely curable , but only palliable with suitable medicines and dietetics such as prameha(obstinate urinary disease), tamaka swasa(bronchial asthma ) etc.
hi: ऐसी बीमारियां जो प्रकृति से पूरी तरह से ठीक नहीं हो सकती हैं , लेकिन केवल उपयुक्त दवाओं और आहार संबंधी उपायों जैसे प्रमेहा (असंत urinary disease), तामाका स्वसा (bronchial tamka breath (दमा)) आदि से ही ठीक हो सकती हैं ।
prepared: the diseases which by nature are not completely curable , but only palliable with suitable medicines and dietetics such as prameha(obstinate urinary disease), tamaka swasa(bronchial तमक श्वास (दमा) ) etc.

en: the diseases which could not be managed at all even with excellence of medicine, physicians, health etc.
hi: उन रोगों का इलाज चिकित्सा, चिकित्सकों, स्वास्थ्य आदि की उत्कृष्टता के साथ भी नहीं किया जा सकता था।
prepared: the diseases which could not be managed at all even with excellence of medicine, physicians, health etc.

en: diseases caused due more than one vitiated dosha
hi: एक से अधिक प्रकुपित दोषों के कारण होने वाली बीमारियां
prepared: diseases caused due more than one प्रकुपित दोष

en: examination / investigation of the disease; it is carried out with the help of pa calakshananidana
hi: रोग की जांच/ जांच; यह पा कल्क्शानिनडाइन की सहायता से किया जाता है
prepared: examination / investigation of the disease; it is carried out with the help of pa calakshananidana

en: the fivefold factors that help in understanding and diagnosis of a disease, including etiology(nidana), purvarupa(prodromal symptoms), rupa(signs and symptoms of the disease), samprapthi(pathogenesis) and upasaya(understanding of aggravating and relieving factors)
hi: रोग की समझ और निदान में सहायक पांच कारक, निदान (कारण) (निदान), पूर्वारूप (पूर्वरूप संबंधी लक्षण), रूप (पूर्वरूप संबंधी लक्षण), लक्षण (पूर्वरूप संबंधी लक्षण), संप्रप्ति (रोगजनन) और उपसाया (उपसाया) (अग्रतरण और राहत कारक) को समझने)
prepared: the fivefold factors that help in understanding and diagnosis of a disease, including निदान (कारण)(निदान), purvarupa(पूर्वरूप संबंधी symptoms), rupa(signs and symptoms of the disease), samprapthi(सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन)) and upasaya(understanding of aggravating and relieving factors)

en: the factors that directly or indirectly act as aetiology of a disease.
hi: ऐसे कारक जो किसी रोग के निदान (कारण) के रूप में प्रत्यक्ष या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से कार्य करते हैं।
prepared: the factors that directly or indirectly act as निदान (कारण) of a disease.

en: the term literally means causative factors of the disease. ayurveda gives immense importance to understanding the cause of the disease and mentions evading the cause as prime and important measure in preventing or curing a disease. they are classified into different categories.
hi: आयुर्वेद में रोग के कारण को समझने के लिए बहुत महत्व दिया गया है और रोग को रोकने या ठीक करने के लिए इसका बचाव करना एक प्रमुख और महत्वपूर्ण उपाय है।
prepared: the term literally means causative factors of the disease. आयुर्वेद gives immense importance to understanding the cause of the disease and mentions evading the cause as prime and important measure in preventing or curing a disease. they are classified into different categories.

en: synonym of nidana which literally means sakuna(omen or prognostic).
hi: निदान का पर्यायवाची जिसका शाब्दिक अर्थ है सकुना (अर्थात् भविष्यसूचक) ।
prepared: synonym of निदान which literally means sakuna(omen or prognostic).

en: synonym of nidana which means cause of disease.ayatana also means the site which provide shelter .
hi: निदान का पर्यायवाची जिसका अर्थ है रोग का कारण .
prepared: synonym of निदान which means cause of disease.ayatana also means the site which provide shelter .

en: synonym of nidana which literally means the perpetrator; that which act as cause of disease
hi: निदान का पर्यायवाची जिसका शाब्दिक अर्थ है अपराधी; जो रोग का कारण बनता है
prepared: synonym of निदान which literally means the perpetrator; that which act as cause of disease

hi: शब्द मूल कारण को दर्शाता है

en: synonym of nidana meaning cause; used in terms of faith also
hi: निदान का पर्यायवाची अर्थ कारण; विश्वास के संदर्भ में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है
prepared: synonym of निदान meaning cause; used in terms of faith also

en: literal meaning of the word implies origin/progress of a disease which would point to its aetiology
hi: शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ रोग की उत्पत्ति/प्रगति को इंगित करता है जो उसके निदान (कारण) की ओर इशारा करता है।
prepared: literal meaning of the word implies origin/progress of a disease which would point to its निदान (कारण)

en: the two fold type of aetiological factors that is based on the nature of etiology as those which directly cause disease and those which act as additional cause in manifestation of disease
hi: दो गुना प्रकार के एटीओलॉजिकल कारक जो निदान (कारण) की प्रकृति पर आधारित हैं, जैसे कि वे जो सीधे बीमारी का कारण बनते हैं और वे जो बीमारी के प्रकट होने में अतिरिक्त कारण के रूप में कार्य करते हैं
prepared: the two fold type of aetiological factors that is based on the nature of निदान (कारण) as those which directly cause disease and those which act as additional cause in manifestation of disease

en: etiological factors that act as direct cause for the initiation of a disease by favouring accumulation of respective doshas
hi: ऐसे एटीओलॉजिकल कारक जो संबंधित दोषों के जमा होने का लाभ उठाते हुए रोग की शुरुआत के लिए प्रत्यक्ष कारण के रूप में कार्य करते हैं।
prepared: etiological factors that act as direct cause for the initiation of a disease by favouring accumulation of respective दोष

en: etiological cause that sustains the aggravation and stimulates progression of a disease
hi: रोग का प्रकोप और प्रगति को प्रोत्साहित करने वाला एटीओलॉजिकल कारण
prepared: etiological cause that sustains the प्रकोप and stimulates progression of a disease

en: external causes that include vitiation of dosha through alterations in food, behavioral aspects and time
hi: भोजन, व्यवहारिक पहलुओं और समय में परिवर्तन के माध्यम से दोष के दुष्टि (प्रकोप) सहित बाहरी कारण
prepared: external causes that include दुष्टि (प्रकोप) of दोष through alterations in food, behavioral aspects and time

en: internal factors like doṣa, dushya that exist inside the body which act as the ultimate cause in disease manifestation, when deviated from normal stage of equilibrium
hi: दोष, दुष्य जैसे आंतरिक कारक जो शरीर के अंदर मौजूद होते हैं जो रोग की अभिव्यक्ति में अंतिम कारण के रूप में कार्य करते हैं, जब संतुलन के सामान्य चरण से विचलित होते हैं
prepared: internal factors like दोष, dushya that exist inside the body which act as the ultimate cause in disease manifestation, when deviated from normal stage of equilibrium

en: causes leading to disturbances in the anatomy and physiology of the body
hi: शरीर के शरीर के शरीर रचना और शरीर विज्ञान में विकारों का कारण बनता है
prepared: causes leading to disturbances in the anatomy and physiology of the body

en: causes leading to disturbances in the functions of mind
hi: मन के कार्यों में व्यवधान पैदा करने के कारण
prepared: causes leading to disturbances in the functions of mind

en: classification of etiology into three types including asatmyendriyartha samyoga (improper use of sense organs), prajnaparadha(intellectual blasphemy) and parinama (transformation attributed to time)
hi: निदान (कारण) को तीन प्रकारों में वर्गीकृत करना जिसमें असतमिन्द्रियार्थ समयोग (अर्थय अंगों का अनुचित उपयोग), प्रजनपार्धा (बुद्धिमान धर्मनिंदा) और परिनाम (समय से सम्बंधित परिवर्तन) शामिल हैं।
prepared: classification of निदान (कारण) into three types including asatmyendriyartha samyoga (improper use of sense organs), prajnaparadha(intellectual blasphemy) and parinama (transformation attributed to time)

en: misuse of the senses in wrongful manner, in excess or in less than normal way; included as one of the three prime causes of a disease
hi: अनुचित तरीके से, अधिक या सामान्य से कम तरीके से इंद्रियों का दुरुपयोग; रोग के तीन प्रमुख कारणों में से एक के रूप में शामिल
prepared: misuse of the senses in wrongful manner, in excess or in less than normal way; included as one of the three prime causes of a disease

en: included as one of the three prime causes of a disease; the misuse of a person's intellect in identifying the wholesome / beneficial thing, any act done bereft of intelligence, perseverance and mindfulness. such an act aggravates all the three doṣa thus should be avoided by a wise person
hi: रोग के तीन मुख्य कारणों में से एक के रूप में शामिल; पथ्य / लाभकारी चीज की पहचान करने में किसी व्यक्ति की बुद्धि का दुरुपयोग, बुद्धि, दृढ़ता और ध्यान से वंचित कोई भी कार्य किया जाता है। ऐसा कार्य तीनों दोषों को भी बढ़ाता है। इसलिए एक बुद्धिमान व्यक्ति को इससे बचना चाहिए।
prepared: included as one of the three prime causes of a disease; the misuse of a person's intellect in identifying the पथ्य / beneficial thing, any act done bereft of intelligence, perseverance and mindfulness. such an act aggravates all the three दोष thus should be avoided by a wise person

en: the negative impact of the season; included as one of the three prime causes of a disease
hi: मौसम का नकारात्मक प्रभाव; किसी बीमारी के तीन मुख्य कारणों में से एक के रूप में शामिल
prepared: the negative impact of the season; included as one of the three prime causes of a disease

en: the seasonal variations causing natural accumulation and aggravation of the doṣa
hi: दोष के प्राकृतिक जमाव और प्रकोप का कारण बनने वाले मौसमी भिन्नताएं
prepared: the seasonal variations causing natural accumulation and प्रकोप of the दोष

en: the normal physiological state of dosa which brings about state of equilibrium and health in body
hi: दोष की सामान्य शारीरिक अवस्था जो शरीर में संतुलन और स्वास्थ्य की स्थिति को जन्म देती है
prepared: the normal physiological state of दोष which brings about state of equilibrium and health in body

en: the deviation of dosa from normal physiological state of equilibrium with derangement of functional, qualitative or quantitative aspects of dosa which is the basis for disease
hi: दोष के सामान्य शारीरिक संतुलन की स्थिति से दोष के कार्यात्मक, गुणात्मक या मात्रात्मक पहलुओं के वैषम्य के साथ विचलन जो रोग का आधार है
prepared: the deviation of दोष from normal physiological state of equilibrium with वैषम्य of functional, qualitative or quantitative aspects of दोष which is the basis for disease

en: independent disease having its own set of symptoms and classical line of therapy
hi: लक्षणों का अपना सेट और उपचार की शास्त्रीय पंक्ति वाला स्वतंत्र रोग
prepared: independent disease having its own set of symptoms and classical line of therapy

en: any disease which does not have an independent existence or line of treatment
hi: कोई भी रोग जिसके स्वतंत्र अस्तित्व या उपचार की कोई पंक्ति नहीं है
prepared: any disease which does not have an independent existence or line of treatment

en: state of normalcy in any aspect without any deviation or derangement from normal state, function or quality
hi: सामान्य स्थिति, कार्य या गुणवत्ता से कोई विचलन या वैश्यता के बिना किसी भी पहलू में सामान्य स्थिति
prepared: state of normalcy in any aspect without any deviation or वैषम्य from normal state, function or quality

en: not normal; differing in any way from the usual state, structure or condition
hi: सामान्य नहीं; सामान्य अवस्था, संरचना या स्थिति से किसी भी तरह भिन्न
prepared: not normal; differing in any way from the usual state, structure or condition

en: specific term which represents a pathological phenomenon when vitiated vata dosa forcefully shifts another dosha from its normal site to another and produces symptoms
hi: एक विशिष्ट शब्द जो एक रोग संबंधी घटना का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जब प्रकुपित वात दोष बलपूर्वक अपनी सामान्य स्थान से दूसरे दोष को स्थानांतरित करता है और लक्षण पैदा करता है
prepared: specific term which represents a pathological phenomenon when प्रकुपित वात दोष forcefully shifts another दोष from its normal site to another and produces symptoms

en: the movement of doshas within the body(apart from physiological movement) is a pathogenic mechanism which results in manifestation of disease in different tracts
hi: शरीर के भीतर दोष की गति (जिसे शारीरिक गति के अलावा) एक रोगजनक तंत्र है जिसके परिणामस्वरूप विभिन्न मार्गों में रोग की अभिव्यक्ति होती है।
prepared: the movement of दोष within the body(apart from physiological movement) is a pathogenic mechanism which results in manifestation of disease in different tracts

en: the term signifies spread of the vitiated dosha
prepared: the term signifies spread of the प्रकुपित दोष

en: movements of doṣa towards tissues (shakha), either physiological or pathological; manifestation of diseases occur when the vitiated dosas gets dislodged in sakha
hi: ऊतकों की ओर दोष की गति (शाखा) शारीरिक या रोग संबंधी हो; रोगों की अभिव्यक्ति तब होती है जब प्रकुपित खुराक साखा में विस्थापित हो जाती है।
prepared: movements of दोष towards tissues (shakha), either physiological or pathological; manifestation of diseases occur when the प्रकुपित dosas gets dislodged in sakha

en: dosa when associated with ama undergoes qualitative and functional alteration and become capable of producing diseases. āma: The term is used as a technical word for anything that exists in a state of incomplete transformation. It is mentioned in various contexts like a) In particular, it can refer to a toxic by product generated due to improper or incomplete digestion. b) Toxins that were produced at any stage of metabolism and that are circulating through the channels are also sometimes. c) The first stage of any disease is also frequently. d) Any substance which is present in its abnormal state and is unwanted in the body. It represents, in a gross sense, mere indigestion which begins in the stomach, to, in a finer sense, even a faulty enzymatic pathway that prevents or hampers a metabolic cycle or chain. It is a very important factor playing a pivotal role in the genesis of any disease. It is also important in determining the prognosis, drug selection and all other stages of therapy.
hi: आम के साथ जुड़े होने पर दोष गुणात्मक और कार्यात्मक परिवर्तन से गुजरता है और रोग पैदा करने में सक्षम हो जाता है। आम: यह शब्द किसी भी चीज के लिए एक तकनीकी शब्द के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है जो अपूर्ण परिवर्तन की स्थिति में मौजूद है। इसका उल्लेख विभिन्न संदर्भों में किया जाता है जैसे कि) विशेष रूप से, यह एक उत्पाद द्वारा एक विषाक्तता को संदर्भित कर सकता है जो अनुचित या अपूर्ण पाचन के कारण उत्पन्न होता है। बी) कभी-कभी चयापचय के किसी भी चरण में उत्पादित होने वाले विषाक्त पदार्थ भी होते हैं और जो चैनलों के माध्यम से संचरण कर रहे हैं। ग) किसी भी बीमारी का पहला चरण भी अक्सर होता है। डी) कोई भी पदार्थ जो अपनी असामान्य स्थिति में मौजूद है और शरीर में अवांछित है। यह एक गंभीर अर्थ में, सिर्फ अजीर्ण (चैसिस) का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है जो पेट में, एक बारीक अर्थ में, एक दोषपूर्ण एंजाइमिक मार्ग को रोकता है जो चयापचय या किसी अन्य श्रृंखला चक्र में बाधा डालता है। यह किसी भी बीमारी के विकास के चरणों में एक बहुत महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, और यह सभी चरणों में एक महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।
prepared: दोष when associated with आम undergoes qualitative and functional alteration and become capable of producing diseases. आम: The term is used as a technical word for anything that exists in a state of incomplete transformation. It is mentioned in various contexts like a) In particular, it can refer to a toxic by product generated due to improper or incomplete digestion. b) Toxins that were produced at any stage of metabolism and that are circulating through the channels are also sometimes. c) The first stage of any disease is also frequently. d) Any substance which is present in its abnormal state and is unwanted in the body. It represents, in a gross sense, mere अजीर्ण (अपच) which begins in the stomach, to, in a finer sense, even a faulty enzymatic pathway that prevents or hampers a metabolic cycle or chain. It is a very important factor playing a pivotal role in the genesis of any disease. It is also important in determining the prognosis, द्रव्य selection and all other stages of therapy.

en: when ama associated with any dosha undergoes depletion, the resultant dosha is termed as nirama, which is still in vitiated state and has not returned to normalcy
hi: जब किसी दोष से जुड़े आम को समाप्त हो जाता है, तो परिणामी दोष को निरमा कहा जाता है, जो अभी भी प्रकुपित स्थिति में है और सामान्य स्थिति में वापस नहीं आया है।
prepared: when आम associated with any दोष undergoes depletion, the resultant दोष is termed as nirama, which is still in प्रकुपित state and has not returned to normalcy

en: causes which aggravate doṣa irrespective of the disease
hi: रोग की परवाह किए बिना दोष को बढ़ाता है
prepared: causes which aggravate दोष irrespective of the disease

en: factors that cause a disease irrespective of the doṣa involved in it
hi: रोग के कारण होने वाले कारक, उसमें शामिल दोषों के बावजूद
prepared: factors that cause a disease irrespective of the दोष involved in it

en: factors which not only aggravate particular dosha but also cause for a particular disease; causes affecting both mind and body
hi: ऐसे कारक जो न केवल किसी विशेष दोष को बढ़ाते हैं बल्कि किसी विशेष रोग का कारण भी बनते हैं; मानसिक और शारीरिक दोनों को प्रभावित करने वाले कारण
prepared: factors which not only aggravate particular दोष but also cause for a particular disease; causes affecting both mind and body

en: the classification of hetu as four types based on its capability in producing disease
hi: हेट्यू को चार प्रकारों में वर्गीकृत करना रोग पैदा करने की क्षमता के आधार पर
prepared: the classification of hetu as four types based on its capability in producing disease

en: the potent cause which can directly cause a disease i.e. ruksha diet is the sannikrishta nidan for vatika type of jwara
hi: एक रोग का सीधा कारण बन सकता है अर्थात रक्ष आहार वतीका प्रकार के ज्वारा के लिए सनीकृष्ण निदान है।
prepared: the potent cause which can directly cause a disease i.e. ruksha diet is the sannikrishta nidan for vatika type of jwara

en: distant causative factors which are comparatively less influential in causing a disease i.e. rudra kopa (wrath of god rudra) is said as viprakrushta hetu for jwara
hi: दूर के कारण कारक जो रोग का कारण बनने में अपेक्षाकृत कम प्रभावशाली होते हैं अर्थात् रुद्रा कोपा (भगवान रुद्रा का क्रोध) को ज्वारा के लिए विप्राक्रुष्ट हेतू कहा जाता है।
prepared: distant causative factors which are comparatively less influential in causing a disease i.e. rudra kopa (wrath of god rudra) is said as viprakrushta hetu for jwara

en: non - dominant causative factor; thus cannot independently cause a disease and may produce when suitable situation arises in body
hi: गैर-अधिशासित कारण कारक; इस प्रकार स्वतंत्र रूप से कोई रोग नहीं पैदा कर सकता है और शरीर में उपयुक्त स्थिति उत्पन्न होने पर उत्पन्न हो सकता है
prepared: non - dominant causative factor; thus cannot independently cause a disease and may produce when suitable situation arises in body

en: dominant causative factors which play dominant role in causing a disease; such factors produce instantaneous dosha dushti and are very potent in causation of disease e.g. poison
hi: रोग के कारण होने में प्रमुख कारक जो प्रमुख भूमिका निभाते हैं; ऐसे कारक तत्काल दोष दोश्टी उत्पन्न करते हैं और रोग के कारण होने में बहुत शक्तिशाली होते हैं जैसे विष।
prepared: dominant causative factors which play dominant role in causing a disease; such factors produce instantaneous दोष dushti and are very potent in causation of disease e.g. विष

en: it is the premonitory symptom by learning about which one can avoid the manifestation of the disease; depending on their nature they are classified into two types
hi: यह रोग की अभिव्यक्ति से बचने के लिए सीखने के द्वारा पूर्व-प्रतीकात्मक लक्षण है; उनकी प्रकृति के आधार पर वे दो प्रकार में वर्गीकृत किए जाते हैं
prepared: it is the premonitory symptom by learning about which one can avoid the manifestation of the disease; depending on their nature they are classified into two types

en: classification of prodromal symptoms on the basis of their general and specific nature, which points to any disease or any particular disease
hi: पूर्वरूप संबंधी लक्षणों का वर्गीकरण उनके सामान्य और विशिष्ट प्रकृति के आधार पर, जो किसी रोग या किसी विशेष रोग को इंगित करता है
prepared: classification of पूर्वरूप संबंधी symptoms on the basis of their general and specific nature, which points to any disease or any particular disease

en: they signify two meanings a) specific symptom pertaining to particular dosha. b) those premonitory symptoms which convert into signs and symptoms of a particular condition.
hi: वे दो अर्थों को दर्शाते हैं: (क) विशेष लक्षण जो किसी विशेष दोष से संबंधित है। (ख) वे पूर्वदर्शी लक्षण जो किसी विशेष स्थिति के संकेतों और लक्षणों में बदल जाते हैं।
prepared: they signify two meanings a) specific symptom pertaining to particular दोष. b) those premonitory symptoms which convert into signs and symptoms of a particular condition.

en: they signify two meanings a) general premonitory symptoms b) those premonitory symptoms which does not convert into signs and symptoms.
hi: वे दो अर्थों को दर्शाते हैं (क) सामान्य पूर्वदर्शी लक्षण (ख) वे पूर्वदर्शी लक्षण जो संकेतों और लक्षणों में परिवर्तित नहीं होते हैं।
prepared: they signify two meanings a) general premonitory symptoms b) those premonitory symptoms which does not convert into signs and symptoms.

en: any morbid phenomenon or departure from the normal in structure, function, or sensation, experienced by either the patient or physician and indicative of disease syn: li~gaga
hi: किसी भी विकृत घटना या संरचना, कार्य या संवेदना में सामान्य से विचलन, जो रोगी या चिकित्सक द्वारा अनुभव किया जाता है और रोग का संकेत है
prepared: any विकृत phenomenon or departure from the normal in structure, function, or sensation, experienced by either the patient or physician and indicative of disease syn: li~gaga

en: various synonyms of linga such as lakshana, chihna, akrti etc
hi: लिंग के विभिन्न पर्यायवाची जैसे लक्षणा, चिन्हा, अकरती आदि
prepared: various synonyms of linga such as lakshana, chihna, akrti etc

en: synonyms of liṅga; denotes the symptoms that is manifested in a disease.
hi: लिंग के पर्यायवाची; रोग में प्रकट होने वाले लक्षणों को दर्शाता है।
prepared: synonyms of लिङ्ग; denotes the symptoms that is manifested in a disease.

en: synonyms of liṅga; any morbid phenomenon or departure from the normal in structure, function, or sensation, understood by physician which is indicative of disease.
hi: लिंग के पर्यायवाची; किसी विकृत घटना या संरचना, कार्य या संवेदना में सामान्य से विचलन, जो चिकित्सक द्वारा समझा जाता है जो बीमारी का संकेत है।
prepared: synonyms of लिङ्ग; any विकृत phenomenon or departure from the normal in structure, function, or sensation, understood by physician which is indicative of disease.

en: synonyms of liṅga; signs which points toward any disease such as krichraswasanam (difficulty breathing) pointing towards swasa roga ( respiratory disease)
hi: लिङ्ग के पर्याय; ऐसे संकेत जो किसी भी रोग जैसे कि krichraswasanam (श्वास लेने में कठिनाई) की ओर इशारा करते हैं और स्वासा रोगा (श्वासने की बीमारी) की ओर इशारा करते हैं।
prepared: synonyms of लिङ्ग; signs which points toward any disease such as krichraswasanam (difficulty breathing) pointing towards swasa roga ( respiratory disease)

en: synonyms of liṅga; literal meaning denotes the type of manifestation in the body
hi: लिङ्ग के पर्याय; शाब्दिक अर्थ शरीर में प्रकट होने की प्रकार को दर्शाता है
prepared: synonyms of लिङ्ग; literal meaning denotes the type of manifestation in the body

en: synonyms of liṅga; this term denotes the manifestations of disease
hi: लिंग के पर्याय; यह शब्द रोग की अभिव्यक्ति को दर्शाता है
prepared: synonyms of लिङ्ग; this term denotes the manifestations of disease

en: the symptoms and signs that points to a normal state after the expulsion of vitiated doshas.
hi: प्रकुपित दोष के निष्कासन के बाद सामान्य स्थिति की ओर संकेत देने वाले लक्षण और संकेत।
prepared: the symptoms and signs that points to a normal state after the expulsion of प्रकुपित दोष.

en: the signs and symptoms of improvement signifying relief / alleviation of the disease.
hi: रोग की राहत / राहत के संकेत और सुधार के लक्षण।
prepared: the signs and symptoms of improvement signifying relief / alleviation of the disease.

en: classification of assuagement on the basis of their nature
hi: उनकी प्रकृति के आधार पर राहत का वर्गीकरण
prepared: classification of assuagement on the basis of their nature

en: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is antagonistic to the etiology of disease
hi: दवाओं, आहार और आहार का विवेकपूर्ण उपयोग जो रोग के निदान (कारण) के प्रति विरोधी हो
prepared: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is antagonistic to the निदान (कारण) of disease

en: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is antagonistic to the nature of disease itself.
hi: दवाओं, आहार और आहार का उचित उपयोग जो रोग की प्रकृति के विपरीत है।
prepared: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is antagonistic to the nature of disease itself.

en: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that are antagonistic to both the etiology and disease itself.
hi: दवाओं, आहार और आहार के विवेकपूर्ण उपयोग जो निदान (कारण) और बीमारी दोनों के प्रति विरोधी हैं।
prepared: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that are antagonistic to both the निदान (कारण) and disease itself.

en: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is similar to the etiology, but capable of producing assuagement
hi: निदान (कारण) के समान दवाओं, आहार और आहार का उचित उपयोग, लेकिन राहत पैदा करने में सक्षम
prepared: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is similar to the निदान (कारण), but capable of producing assuagement

en: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is similar to both the etiology and disease, but capable of producing assuagement.
hi: दवाओं, आहार और आहार का उचित उपयोग जो निदान (कारण) और रोग दोनों के समान है, लेकिन राहत पैदा करने में सक्षम है।
prepared: judicious use of medicines, regimen and dietetics that is similar to both the निदान (कारण) and disease, but capable of producing assuagement.

en: intervention of the diet and medicine which is neither good for health nor for diseases. and it is one of the tools of the diagnosis where the diseases cannot be diagnosed by referring merely its clinical features.
hi: यह आहार और दवाओं का हस्तक्षेप है जो स्वास्थ्य के लिए अच्छा नहीं है और न ही रोगों के लिए। और यह निदान के साधनों में से एक है जहां रोगों का निदान केवल इसके नैदानिक लक्षणों का उल्लेख करके नहीं किया जा सकता है।
prepared: intervention of the diet and medicine which is neither good for health nor for diseases. and it is one of the tools of the diagnosis where the diseases cannot be diagnosed by referring merely its clinical features.

en: the term signifies the mechanism starting from vitiation of doṣa till the origin and complete manifestation / development of the disease. further pathogenesis is classified into six types.
hi: शब्द दोष के दुष्टि (प्रकोप) से लेकर रोग की उत्पत्ति और पूर्ण प्रकटीकरण/विकास तक के तंत्र को दर्शाता है। आगे सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) को छह प्रकार में वर्गीकृत किया गया है।
prepared: the term signifies the mechanism starting from दुष्टि (प्रकोप) of दोष till the origin and complete manifestation / development of the disease. further सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) is classified into six types.

en: classification of the pathogenesis according to enumeration.
hi: सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) का वर्गीकरण गणना के अनुसार।
prepared: classification of the सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) according to enumeration.

en: classification of the pathogenesis according to primary or secondary ailment
hi: सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) को प्राथमिक या माध्यमिक बीमारी के अनुसार वर्गीकरण
prepared: classification of the सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) according to primary or secondary ailment

en: classification of the pathogenesis according to the categorization based on various aspects such as based on prognosis a disease can be classified as saadhya (easily curable), aasadhya( incurable), krichsaadhya(difficult to cure) etc.
hi: सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) को विभिन्न पहलुओं के आधार पर वर्गीकरण के अनुसार वर्गीकृत किया जाता है जैसे कि पूर्वानुमान के आधार पर किसी रोग को साधे (सुलभ इलाज योग्य), आसधे (अनिवार्य), कृषसेध (अनिवार्य) आदि के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जा सकता है।
prepared: classification of the सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) according to the categorization based on various aspects such as based on prognosis a disease can be classified as saadhya (easily curable), aasadhya( incurable), krichsaadhya(difficult to cure) etc.

en: classification of the pathogenesis according to the predominance of one or other fraction of the three doshas
hi: सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) को तीन दोषों में से एक या दूसरे अंश के प्रचलितता के अनुसार वर्गीकरण
prepared: classification of the सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) according to the predominance of one or other fraction of the three दोष

en: classification of the pathogenesis according to strength of the disease
hi: रोग की तीव्रता के अनुसार सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) का वर्गीकरण
prepared: classification of the सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) according to strength of the disease

en: classification of the pathogenesis according to time of occurrence or aggravation of the disease
hi: रोग के होने या प्रकोप के समय के अनुसार सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) का वर्गीकरण
prepared: classification of the सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) according to time of occurrence or प्रकोप of the disease

en: the diseases that develop subsequent to a disease or during the course of the main disease that is being treated, and is dependent upon the main disease for its origination, nature and the strength. it is called secondary in the sense that its onset follows the presence of the primary disease
hi: ऐसी बीमारियां जो किसी बीमारी के बाद या इलाज की जा रही मुख्य बीमारी के दौरान विकसित होती हैं और इसकी उत्पत्ति, प्रकृति और ताकत के लिए मुख्य बीमारी पर निर्भर होती हैं। इसे माध्यमिक कहा जाता है क्योंकि इसकी शुरुआत प्राथमिक बीमारी की उपस्थिति के बाद होती है।
prepared: the diseases that develop subsequent to a disease or during the course of the main disease that is being treated, and is dependent upon the main disease for its origination, nature and the strength. it is called secondary in the sense that its onset follows the presence of the primary disease

en: complications caused during therapeutic procedures like panchakrma (eg. basti vyapada)
hi: उपचारात्मक प्रक्रियाओं जैसे पंचक्रमा (जैसे बास्ती वपाडा) के दौरान होने वाली जटिलताओं
prepared: complications caused during therapeutic procedures like panchakrma (eg. basti vyapada)

en: complications that arise during treatment due to non- obedience from the side of the patient
hi: रोगी की ओर से न मानने के कारण उपचार के दौरान होने वाली जटिलताओं
prepared: complications that arise during treatment due to non- obedience from the side of the patient

en: complications that arise by the false application of medical or surgical procedures
hi: चिकित्सा या सर्जिकल प्रक्रियाओं के गलत आवेदन से उत्पन्न होने वाली जटिलताएं
prepared: complications that arise by the false application of medical or surgical procedures

en: complications which arise as a result of improper usage of drugs, usage of poor standard drugs etc.
hi: द्रव्य के अनुचित उपयोग, खराब मानक द्रव्य के उपयोग आदि के परिणामस्वरूप उत्पन्न होने वाली जटिलताओं
prepared: complications which arise as a result of improper usage of द्रव्य, usage of poor standard द्रव्य etc.

en: fatal sign and symptoms which arises in patients denoting poor prognosis or death
hi: खराब भविष्यवाणी या मृत्यु का संकेत देने वाले रोगियों में उत्पन्न होने वाले घातक संकेत और लक्षण
prepared: fatal sign and symptoms which arises in patients denoting poor prognosis or death

en: the term signifies different stages of diseases.
hi: इस शब्द का अर्थ रोगों के विभिन्न चरणों को दर्शाता है।
prepared: the term signifies different stages of diseases.

en: the transforming phase of a disease-course or vrana denoting post- inflammatory condition /suppurative condition of a disease or vrana.
hi: रोग-क्रम या रोग-रोग की परिवर्तनशील अवस्था जो रोग या रोग की सूजन/सुपरटिव स्थिति के बाद की स्थिति को दर्शाता है।
prepared: the transforming phase of a disease-course or vrana denoting post- inflammatory condition /suppurative condition of a disease or vrana.

en: the transforming phase of a disease-course or vrana denoting the inflammatory condition.
hi: सूजन संबंधी स्थिति को दर्शाने वाले रोग-क्रम या रोग के परिवर्तन चरण।
prepared: the transforming phase of a disease-course or vrana denoting the inflammatory condition.

en: state when the ama state is converted by either the effect of time or therapeutic measures
hi: स्थिति जब आम स्थिति समय या चिकित्सीय उपायों के प्रभाव से परिवर्तित होती है
prepared: state when the आम state is converted by either the effect of time or therapeutic measures

en: six chief stages in the management of diseases/ step wise description of a disease's pathogenesis.
hi: रोग प्रबंधन में 6 मुख्य चरण/ रोग के सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) का चरणबद्ध वर्णन।
prepared: six chief stages in the management of diseases/ step wise description of a disease's सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन).

en: it is the first stage of kriyakala. the stage of accumulation of doshas in their own place (swasthana)
hi: यह कृयाकाल का पहला चरण है दोषों का अपने स्थान पर जमा होने का चरण (स्वस्थाना)
prepared: it is the first stage of kriyakala. the stage of accumulation of दोष in their own place (swasthana)

en: it is the second stage of kriyakala. the stage of provocation or aggravation of the doshas.
hi: यह कृयाकला का दूसरा चरण है, दोष का प्रकोप या प्रकोप।
prepared: it is the second stage of kriyakala. the stage of provocation or प्रकोप of the दोष.

en: it is the third stage of kriyakala. prasara means leave & spread and thus it is the stage of migration of vitiated doshas from their usual places to different places.
hi: यह कृयाकला का तीसरा चरण है। प्रसारा का अर्थ है छोड़ना और फैलना और इस प्रकार यह प्रकुपित दोष के प्रवासन का चरण है।
prepared: it is the third stage of kriyakala. prasara means leave & spread and thus it is the stage of migration of प्रकुपित दोष from their usual places to different places.

en: it is the fourth stage of kriyakala. the term literally means taking shelter in a place. it is the stage of disease augmentation wherein the vitiated doshas lodges into other body parts consisting of khavaigunya(vacant space) and causes functional, structural or both deformities.
hi: यह शब्द शाब्दिक रूप से किसी स्थान पर शरण लेने का अर्थ है। यह रोग वृद्धि का चरण है जिसमें प्रकुपित दोष ख्वावगुन्या (खावांकित स्थान) से बने शरीर के अन्य अंगों में प्रवेश करता है और कार्यात्मक, संरचनात्मक या दोनों विकृति पैदा करता है।
prepared: it is the fourth stage of kriyakala. the term literally means taking shelter in a place. it is the stage of disease augmentation wherein the प्रकुपित दोष lodges into other body parts consisting of khavaigunya(vacant space) and causes functional, structural or both deformities.

en: it is the fifth stage of kriyakala. the stage of symptom manifestation of the disease.
hi: यह क्रियाकला का पांचवां चरण है। रोग के लक्षण प्रकट होने का चरण है।
prepared: it is the fifth stage of kriyakala. the stage of symptom manifestation of the disease.

en: it is the sixth stage of kriyakala, the stage of complications and here the symptoms can be differentiated on the basis of doshas.
hi: यह क्रियाकाल का छठा चरण है, जटिलताओं का चरण है और यहां दोष के आधार पर लक्षणों को अलग किया जा सकता है।
prepared: it is the sixth stage of kriyakala, the stage of complications and here the symptoms can be differentiated on the basis of दोष.

en: examination of patient done by darshan(observation), sparshan(palpation) and prashna (interrogation).
hi: रोगी की परीक्षा दर्शन (निरीक्षण), स्पार्शन (पल्पाशन) और प्रज्ञा (प्रश्न) द्वारा की जाती है।
prepared: examination of patient done by darshan(observation), sparshan(palpation) and prashna (interrogation).

en: examination of patient done by five senses and interrogation.
hi: पांच इंद्रियों द्वारा किए गए रोगी की जांच और पूछताछ।
prepared: examination of patient done by five senses and interrogation.

en: eight folds examination of patient as : 1. examination of pulse (nadi)2. examination of urine (mootra) 3. examination of the excreta (mala) 4 . examination of tongue (jihwa) 5. examination of voice, sounds produced from body like percussion etc. (shabda) 6. tactile examination (sparsha) 7. examination of eyes and eyesight (driga) 8. examination of the body stature (akruti)
hi: आठ गुना रोगी की परीक्षाः 1. नाड़ी परीक्षा (नदी) 2. मूत्र (मोत्र) 3. मल (मल) 4. जीभ (जह्वा) 5. आवाज, शरीर से धड़कन जैसे ध्वनि आदि की परीक्षा (शब्दा) 6. स्पर्श (स्पार्शा) 7. आंखों और दृष्टि (द्रिगा) 8. शरीर की ऊंचाई (अख्रुति) की परीक्षा
prepared: eight folds examination of patient as : 1. नाड़ी परीक्षा (nadi)2. examination of urine (mootra) 3. examination of the excreta (मल) 4 . examination of tongue (jihwa) 5. examination of voice, sounds produced from body like percussion etc. (shabda) 6. tactile examination (sparsha) 7. examination of eyes and eyesight (driga) 8. examination of the body stature (akruti)

en: ten folds of examination considering below mentioned criteria: 1. physical constitution (prakruti) 2. morbidity (vikruti) 3. excellence of dushya or tissue elements (sara). 4. compactness or tissues or organs (samhanana) 5. measurement of body constituents (pramana) 6. homologation (saatmya). 7. psycic condition (satwa) 8. power of intake and digestion of food (aaharshakti) 9. power of performing exercise (vyayam shakti) 10. age (vayah)
hi: निम्नलिखित मानदंडों पर विचार करते हुए दस गुना परीक्षाः 1. शारीरिक प्रकृति (प्रकृति) 2. रोगाणुत्व (विकृति) 3. दुष्य या ऊतक तत्वों (सारा) की उत्कृष्टता 4. संपीड़न या ऊतक या अंगों (समाना) 5. शरीर के घटकों (प्रमान) 6. homologation (saatmya) 7. मानसिक स्थिति (सत्ता) 8. भोजन के सेवन और पाचन शक्ति (अहरशक्ति) 9. व्यायाम करने की शक्ति (वयाम शक्ति) 10. आयु (वयाह)
prepared: ten folds of examination considering below mentioned criteria: 1. physical प्रकृति (prakruti) 2. morbidity (vikruti) 3. excellence of dushya or tissue elements (sara). 4. compactness or tissues or organs (samhanana) 5. measurement of body constituents (pramana) 6. homologation (saatmya). 7. psycic condition (satwa) 8. power of सेवन and digestion of food (aaharshakti) 9. power of performing exercise (vyayam shakti) 10. age (vayah)

en: resisting power of the body, which reacts to arrest the progress, occurrence, and reoccurrence of diseases
hi: शरीर की प्रतिरोध शक्ति, जो रोगों की प्रगति, घटना और पुनरावृत्ति को रोकने के लिए प्रतिक्रिया करती है
prepared: resisting power of the body, which reacts to arrest the progress, occurrence, and reoccurrence of diseases

en: natural, non-specific type of immunity which defends the body in the first occurrence of any disease.
hi: किसी भी बीमारी की पहली घटना में शरीर की रक्षा करने वाली प्राकृतिक, गैर-विशिष्ट प्रतिरक्षा प्रकार।
prepared: natural, non-specific type of immunity which defends the body in the first occurrence of any disease.

en: body's defence mechanism which checks the occurrence or reoccurrence of diseases.
hi: रोगों की घटना या पुनरावृत्ति की जांच करने वाले शरीर के रक्षा तंत्र।
prepared: body's defence mechanism which checks the occurrence or reoccurrence of diseases.

en: complete or partial obstruction in the body channels leading their malfunctioning.
hi: स्रोतों में पूर्ण या आंशिक अवरोध जो उनके खराब होने का कारण बनता है।
prepared: complete or partial obstruction in the स्रोतस् leading their malfunctioning.

en: the term physiological or structural signifies deformity in the body channels leading to manifestation of the diseases.
hi: शारीरिक या संरचनात्मक शब्द रोगों के प्रकट होने के कारण स्रोतों में विकृति को दर्शाता है।
prepared: the term physiological or structural signifies deformity in the स्रोतस् leading to manifestation of the diseases.

en: the term signifies the etiological factors for the deformity in the body channels
hi: शब्द स्रोतों में विरूपण के लिए एटीओलॉजिकल कारकों को दर्शाता है
prepared: the term signifies the etiological factors for the deformity in the स्रोतस्

en: types of the deformity in the body channels
prepared: types of the deformity in the स्रोतस्

en: obstruction in the pathway of body channels which restricts the movements and may also forms a collateral way sometimes

prepared: obstruction in the pathway of स्रोतस् which restricts the movements and may also forms a collateral way sometimes

en: literally, it signifies parts or items that are grouped together. generally the term is used to state the involvement of all the three doshas, in the pathogenesis of diseases.
hi: सामान्यतः रोगों के सम्प्राप्ति (रोगजनन) में तीनों दोषों की भागीदारी को व्यक्त करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है।

en: the simultaneous appearance of two or more illnesses.
hi: दो या अधिक रोगों की एक साथ उपस्थिति।
prepared: the simultaneous appearance of two or more illnesses.

en: the term literally means abode , place where diseases take shelter and from where manifestation of disease occurs.
hi: शब्द का शाब्दिक अर्थ निवास, वह स्थान है जहाँ रोग शरण लेते हैं और रोग का प्रकट होने का स्थान होता है।
prepared: the term literally means abode , place where diseases take shelter and from where manifestation of disease occurs.

en: the abnormal state of the vitiated doṣa where in they become concealed in the body channels and remain opportunistic to cause abnormality in the body in presence of a favourable condition.
hi: प्रकुपित दोष की असामान्य अवस्था जहां वे स्रोत में छिपे रहते हैं और अनुकूल स्थिति की उपस्थिति में शरीर में असामान्यता पैदा करने के लिए अवसरवादी रहते हैं।
prepared: the abnormal state of the प्रकुपित दोष where in they become concealed in the स्रोतस् and remain opportunistic to cause abnormality in the body in presence of a favourable condition.

hi: syn: agantu doshah ref.code: 1.137.0 दोष जब वह दूसरी जगह चले जाते हैं और वहां रोग प्रकट होता है।
prepared: syn: agantu doshah ref.code: 1.137.0 दोष when moves to other place and shows disease manifestation there.

en: the term literally means inhabitant dosha, that is dosha residing at its own place.
hi: शब्द का अर्थ है निवास दोष, अर्थात दोष अपने स्थान पर निवास करता है।
prepared: the term literally means inhabitant दोष, that is दोष residing at its own place.

en: a disease caused due to sannipaata, in which dosha dominance can be understood on the basis of symptoms

prepared: a disease caused due to sannipaata, in which दोष dominance can be understood on the basis of symptoms

en: a disease caused due to sannipaata, in which dosha dominance cannot be understood on the basis of symptoms

prepared: a disease caused due to sannipaata, in which दोष dominance cannot be understood on the basis of symptoms

hi: आधुनिक औषधि विज्ञान में शब्द "द्रव्य" के समान; पदार्थ जिसमें गुण और क्रियाएं अविभाज्य रूप से व्यक्त होती हैं और रस, गुण, वीर्य, विपाक और प्रभाव का उपग्रह होता है

hi: द्रव्य को गुण, वीर्य आदि से श्रेष्ठ या अधिक महत्वपूर्ण बनाने वाले कारक
prepared: factors which make द्रव्य superior or more important that गुण, वीर्य etc.

prepared: द्रव्य is relatively stable than its properties and actions

en: fact of dravya being more eternal than guṇa and karma

prepared: fact of द्रव्य being more eternal than गुण and karma

en: dravya remains the same even though guṇa and karma change by processing

prepared: द्रव्य remains the same even though गुण and karma change by processing

prepared: perceptible by all five senses i.e. द्रव्य can be percieved by all five senses

prepared: an attribute of being the substratum of properties and actions

en: action initiating ability of dravya, only dravya can initiate any action, not their properties

prepared: action initiating ability of द्रव्य, only द्रव्य can initiate any action, not their properties

prepared: properties and actions of a substance depends upon the state of द्रव्य

prepared: different parts different effects; properties and actions are specific to the part of the substance;

prepared: naming a द्रव्य based on a specific mark or sign or specific character

prepared: द्रव्य which do not vitiate दोष or धातु and are fit for daily use for a healthy individual

prepared: direct and immediate action of a द्रव्य when it comes in contact with the tongue which are six in number and determined by its p? cabhautika composition

prepared: one among the six types of रस which is saline in nature e.g. common salt

en: one among the six types of rasa which is pungent in nature e.g. pepper
hi: रस के छह प्रकारों में से एक जो प्रकृति में तेज है जैसे मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि. मि
prepared: one among the six types of रस which is pungent in nature e.g. pepper

en: one among the six types of rasa which is bitter in nature e.g. bittergourd
hi: रस के छह प्रकारों में से एक जो प्रकृति में कड़वा है जैसे कड़वा मक्खन
prepared: one among the six types of रस which is bitter in nature e.g. bittergourd

prepared: one among the six types of रस which is astringent in nature e.g. black plum

prepared: latent taste of a द्रव्य which is either not perceived or is perceived towards the end of its contact with the tongue

en: rasa which even though present in the dravya is not perceived by the tongue
hi: रस जो द्रव्य में मौजूद होने के बावजूद जीभ द्वारा नहीं महसूस किया जाता है
prepared: रस which even though present in the द्रव्य is not perceived by the tongue

en: guṇa refers to the properties of drugs and dietary articles which are responsible for their respective action in the body and is defined as the characteristic by which people are attracted towards a particular substance
hi: गुण द्रव्य और आहार वस्तुओं के गुणों को संदर्भित करता है जो शरीर में अपने संबंधित कार्य के लिए जिम्मेदार हैं और इसे उस विशेषता के रूप में परिभाषित किया जाता है जिसके द्वारा लोग किसी विशेष पदार्थ के प्रति आकर्षित होते हैं
prepared: गुण refers to the properties of द्रव्य and dietary articles which are responsible for their respective action in the body and is defined as the characteristic by which people are attracted towards a particular substance

prepared: potency of a द्रव्य in terms of dominant गुण classified into two viz.उष्ण(hot) and वात (cold) or eight viz. guru, snigdha, वात, मृदु, laghu, रूक्ष, उष्ण and तीक्ष्ण by which the द्रव्य brings out the therapeutic effect or action

en: quality of a substance characterized by its gentleness

prepared: quality of a substance characterized by its gentleness

prepared: state of temperature which is neither hot nor cold

en: having strong or higher grade of potency

prepared: having strong or higher grade of potency

en: substances which have a moderate degree of potency
hi: मध्यम स्तर की शक्ति वाली पदार्थ

hi: जो केवल मामूली क्रिया उत्पन्न करते हैं
कोई शक्ति न रखने वाली पदार्थ

en: vipāka is the rasa of the drug after it has undergone digestive and assimilative transformations which is classified into three viz. kaṭu (pungent) amla (sour) madhura(sweet)
